job.rawJd: Position Summary: Precision AQ is looking for a Project Harmonizer who is ready to hit the ground running, stay organized, and help keep projects moving forward. As a Project Coordinator, the employee will support projects from initiation through completion, learning how to manage timelines, budgets, and deliverables while ensuring quality standards are met. The role assists in driving workflows, maintaining clear communication across teams, and keeping project details organized in a collaborative environment. Core Responsibilities: Support day-to-day project activities on assigned accounts, including timelines, status reports, hot sheets, and project routing. Collaborate with team members to maintain open communication, anticipate challenges, and contribute to solutions. Assist with Workfront tasks, including project setup, tracking, reporting, planned hours, and processes. Support programs totaling USD 1M-2M and, upon growth in the role, potentially manage USD 1M-1.5M with oversight. Up to 50 percent of time may be spent on administrative support and duties, with expectations aligned with the manager. Support budget tracking and reporting in partnership with project management, Account, and Finance to ensure accuracy and profitability. Engage in mentorship and training to develop operational and cross-departmental knowledge, collaboration skills, and project-management craft. Promote Precision Principles: Client Service, Purpose, Accountability, Mutual Respect, and Collaboration. Project Coordination: Assist in scheduling and facilitating internal status and kickoff meetings. Deliver proactive updates on timelines and resourcing under guidance while developing the ability to anticipate needs and contribute to solutions. Learn and maintain familiarity with agency framework, clients, and regulatory processes. Help navigate workflow challenges through collaboration, operational efficiency, and accountability. Encourage candid communication during project planning and execution. Learn to identify, assess, and mitigate project risks through observation, proactive escalation, critical questions, alternatives, and possible solutions. Career and Relationship Development: Participate in onboarding and training to learn agency processes, systems, and project-management best practices. Engage in mentorship with senior team members. Collaborate with peers and cross-functional teams to understand workflows and contribute to a positive, team-first environment. Qualifications: A bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, advertising, or a similar field is preferred. One or more years of experience in a professional environment is preferred. Healthcare, pharmaceutical, or related life-sciences experience is a plus. Skills: Experience with Microsoft Office Suite and the Mac operating system. Competencies: collaboration, adaptability, initiative with managerial support, and accountability. Compensation: reasonable estimate of the current range is USD 40,000-60,000. The role is eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, health insurance, retirement savings benefits, life insurance and disability benefits, parental leave, and paid time off. Precision Medicine Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Application data is stored in accordance with the company's Privacy Policy and applicable California privacy notice. Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation may contact Precision Medicine Group through its published HR channel. Precision Medicine Group warns applicants that it will never request payment, banking details, or other sensitive financial information during recruiting.
